description: A promotion stage that downloads the image archive (and could push it) is rejected.

patches.replace:
- task: DownloadPipelineArtifact@2
                  inputs:
                    buildType: current
                    artifactName: image
                    targetPath: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/image
                  target:
                    commands: restricted
                - ${{ if eq(parameters.environment.kind, 'prod') }}:
                  - task: DownloadPipelineArtifact@2
